item.title: Survey: More than 2 in 5 Americans believe financial secrets are at least as bad as cheating
item.description: Bigger secrets can impact relationships — and livelihoods.

item.title: Kevin McGonigle preparing for any position, but aiming for shortstop
item.description: Sometimes it’s easy to spot a future star from across a field. Some basketball players look carved from marble. Some football players look engineered in a lab. Even in baseball, there are plenty of broad-shouldered sluggers and towering power arms who stand out before they step on the field.

item.title: Overheard in Michigan State’s locker room: Atrocious on boards and boneheaded mistakes
item.description: Another road loss, another court storming. For the second time in a little more than a week, Michigan State got thumped on the road and had to exit the floor among a sea of opposing fans.

item.title: Recipe: Make these delicious S’Mores Brownies for Valentine’s Day
item.description: Chocolate brownies are baked on a graham cracker crust and then topped with miniature marshmallows.

item.title: Get into national parks free on Feb. 16 — but there’s a catch
item.description: Parks will be free to enter for U.S. legal residents only.

item.title: New car sensors to avoid dangerous ice developed by University of Michigan engineer’s team
item.description: Nilton Renno, professor of climate and space sciences and engineering at UM, and his 12-person team have developed new sensors that can detect water and ice dozens of meters ahead of both automobiles and airplanes.

item.title: No. 2 Michigan routs UCLA 86-56, earns shot at No. 1 in AP Top 25 after Arizona loss
item.description: Yaxel Lendeborg had 17 points and eight rebounds to lead No. 2 Michigan to an 86-65 victory over UCLA on Saturday that puts the program in position to be ranked No. 1 in the AP Top 25 for the first time since 2013.

item.title: Rochester schools opens search for new trustee
item.description: Interviews will be broadcast on RCS cable television.

item.title: Photos of Royal Oak Shrine vs. Waterford Our Lady of the Lakes in a CHSL St. Anne Tournament boys hoops final
item.description: Royal Oak Shrine defeated Waterford Our Lady of the Lakes 41-28 in the CHSL Ste. Anne boys basketball championship Saturday, Feb. 14, 2026 at Oakland University.

item.title: Shrine overcomes slow start to beat Our Lady of the Lakes for CHSL Ste. Anne championship
item.description: Royal Oak Shrine was already feeling good about itself with a six-point lead early in the fourth quarter of Saturday's CHSL Ste. Anne championship against Waterford Our Lady of the Lakes.
